tools.name: cancel_number
tools.description: SENSITIVE: cancel a number at the end of its paid period. Requires login and confirm true after the customer said yes. The number works until cancel_at and reactivate_number undoes it before then.

confirm.description: true once the customer confirmed the cancellation

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Requires login. The customer's card on file, their numbers with status and renewal dates, failed payments with retry dates, and card_url for adding a card.

tools.name: get_number
tools.description: Requires login. One number by id.

tools.name: get_plan_info
tools.description: Plan pricing, forwarding behaviour, cancellation policy, what the service does not do, and the support email. Public.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Price a specific number before buying. Public. Returns total_cents, next_charge_on and the quote_token that purchase_number requires. Show the customer the total and the terms_url before purchasing.

keyword.description: The keyword, for the display form

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Requires login. One receipt with its lines.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Requires login. Charges and their status, newest first, with receipt urls.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: Requires login. The customer's numbers with status, forwarding and renewal dates.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Log the customer out of this browser.

tools.name: purchase_number
tools.description: SENSITIVE: charges the customer and activates the number. Requires login, a quote_token and total_cents from get_quote, accept_terms true and confirm true after the customer said yes to that exact charge. Pays with payment_token (a Stripe shared payment token from the customer's agent wallet) when given, otherwise the card on file; with neither, returns card_required with a card_url for the customer. A wallet-paid number has no card on file: the response says the date a card is needed by. requires_action means the bank wants the customer to authenticate: open handoff_url, then call again with attempt_id.

total_cents.description: The total the customer agreed to, from get_quote

accept_terms.description: true once the customer accepted the terms at terms_url

confirm.description: true once the customer said yes to this exact charge

payment_token.description: Optional Stripe shared payment token (spt_...) from the customer's agent wallet

attempt_id.description: Only when resuming a requires_action or processing result

tools.name: reactivate_number
tools.description: Requires login. Undo a scheduled cancellation.

tools.name: request_login_code
tools.description: Send a 6-digit login code to the customer's email. Logging in with a new email creates the account. Ask the customer for the code from their inbox, then call verify_login_code.

tools.name: search_numbers
tools.description: Search vanity phone numbers that spell a keyword. Public, no login. Returns local numbers near the zip (or the visitor's location) and toll-free numbers, each with e164, display, kind and available_now. Empty results include keyword suggestions.

keyword.description: 2-7 letters or digits the number should spell, e.g. CASA

zip.description: US zip code for local numbers; omit to use the visitor's location

region.description: US (default) or PR for Puerto Rico

show_all.description: Return every match instead of the first five

tools.name: set_forwarding
tools.description: Requires login. Set where calls ring (a phone number) and where texts go (an email). Omit a field to leave it unchanged; pass an empty string to clear it.

forward_calls_to.description: Phone number that should ring, e.g. (305) 555-0134

tools.name: verify_login_code
tools.description: Verify the 6-digit code the customer read from their inbox and log them in. After this every account tool works.
